acceptance_before_failure: Complete application bundle build excluding installed runtimes and synthetic credentials
Actual packaged CMD pinned-manifest check and corrupt-payload rejection
Synthetic in-project model, encrypted key, knowledge and media preservation
First real loopback application startup and compiled frontend response

failure.step: Verify offline reconfiguration, encrypted configuration preservation, and real local startup
failure.cause: The harness used configuration-only -NoStart -Json for a second-click expectation. Configuration-only mode intentionally refuses to operate on a running service; it is not equivalent to the customer's normal launch action.
failure.repair: Test the actual second launch with -Offline -NoBrowser and require the fixed already_running stage while the first process remains alive. Do not relax the production running-service protection.

cold_installation.scope_limit: The run failed before its final acceptance report and actual Chromium offline-media test. External legacy-directory pointer acceptance was not included in this revision.

scope: Historical partial installation/startup proof is retained without changing the failed overall run to success.
